metadata.notes:
Guests:  
Set 3 and Encore -  w/ Jamie Janover
Texas -  W/ Paulina Lamb
Best Feeling -  w/ Josh Clauson  
   
Show and Guest Notes:  
Down a River -  Billy Solo and First time played
Catfish John, Temperance Reel, Until The Music's Over, When I Paint My Masterpiece -  Billy, Keith and Kang only
Until The Music's Over -  Jason on drums, Travis on bass, Keith on acoustic guitar and Billy on electric guitar
When I Paint My Masterpiece -  with Keith on electric guitar and Billy on bass.
Metered Man -  Kyle Solo

Technical Notes:Tracked, Dithered to 16 Bit (Apogee UV22 HR) and converted to 44.1khz using Wavelab 5

P.S. I am getting old and cannot always remember the track names so thanks
     to Freinds of Cheese (http://www.friendsofcheese.com) for helping to remind me.

As Pete Says: SHUTUP AND DANCE !

reviews.reviewbody:
Thank you guys for taping and sharing the history that you captured this magical night!

Pete how the hell are ya?

C from Colorado
sandwiched in the best weekend of my life. thanks for the snappy post. great quality. ill probably listen to this nonstop til red rocks is up. thanks again!

I like the depth & richness of this recording but having taped Hornings before I am surprised by the level of crowd noise, especially during the acoustic set. Its more of a nerdy taping debate for sure but I wonder what benfit running the mid side brought to the overall recording that isn't undone by all the annoying chatter. I would have loved to be able to compare this sound with a mix that had the mk2's or mk21's mixed in.
it was a time out there.  this night had the somber mood with Billy's Hotel Window and Windy Mountain.  That Bumbin Reel is my fav song right now.  Thanks to the tapers and SCI.  Way to go!
